name: The Junior
source:
A continuation of The Sophomore, following the MC from that series as she enters her third year of college while dealing with a fratority and a campus prankster with malicious intent.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Junior]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
本作延续《The Sophomore》的故事，讲述该系列女主人公升入大学三年级后，与一个男女混合的学生联谊会，以及一名心怀恶意的校园恶作剧者周旋的经历。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Junior]Choices Wikia[/url]]
